title: What a Godly Man Does With the Urge to Post It (It's Not About the Likes)
caption:
Something good happens and before you've even felt it, your phone is out.

Posting isn't a sin. But the reach tells you something. It tells you who you think is watching, and whose approval you're living for.

A godly man notices the reach. He keeps some things between him and God. He reads his caption out loud before he posts it. And when he does post, he closes the app and goes back to his life.

"Your Father who sees in secret will reward you." Matthew 6:6

Save this. Next time you reach for the camera, wait ten minutes.
